settlement_source: First official final result of the title event as reported by Source Agencies: governing league (NFL), AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports
settlement_variable: Team reported as holder of the 2027 Pro Football Championship (Super Bowl) per first official final result
tie_handling: Multiple declared title holders: Yes pays $1/N rounded down to cent, No pays remainder
rounding: Tie/cancel payouts rounded DOWN to nearest cent; min tick $0.01
trading_close_vs_settlement: API close_time/expiration 2029-02-13T23:30Z is a placeholder outer bound; real expiration = day after official final result at 10:00 AM ET. Last trading time = expiration time. Settlement <= day after expiration. settlement_timer 300s; can_close_early=1.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed/suspended: stays open until winner reported or 2 years after original date
Cancelled/no contest: eligible teams split $1/N rounded down
Disqualified before expiry -> No; next declared holder wins
Eliminated (per Source Agency) -> resolves No early
Ended early but governing body declares winner -> follows that
Kalshi discretionary Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(d)); Rule 6.3(b) if value undeterminable
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'Pro Football Championship' vs series 'Super Bowl'; terms are generic TITLE.pdf covering NFL/NHL/NBA/NCAA
Series prohibitions say current staff; terms Appendix B says current AND former players/coaches/staff
toxicity_flags: Futures series (32 teams): long shots at 0.01-0.02, tick-size dominated
Elimination resolves No early via Source Agency report: discrete jump events
Insider prohibitions (players, coaches, owners, league staff)
Outcome observable live during game before official result; early close possible
notes: Pure forecast until game day, then live-observable. Reviewed from TITLE.pdf.
